22 compatible agents — hovertap a drop

Squeeze your agent's token bill.

The #1 tool to cut what your AI agent sends to the model.

One install, zero config. Tokenade compacts command output, MCP results, web searches and stale context before the model reads a single line.

100% local · Tokenade never uploads your code or your conversations.

Install Tokenade Install Tokenade ★ Star on GitHub ★ Star on GitHub

Free & open source (MIT/Apache-2.0) · Linux, macOS, Windows

Running in 30 seconds

2 commands
1$npm install -g @tokenade/cli
2$tokenade install
LinuxmacOSWindowsGetting started guide →
  • Detects every agent on the machine and hooks into each one
  • Works on every prompt from then on — nothing to configure
  • `tokenade dashboard` shows every token saved, per feature — in a local report
Free and open source (MIT/Apache-2.0)

What gets squeezed

10 layers · automatic
Command compaction

Noisy command output, compacted

Builds, tests, logs — every noisy output trimmed to what matters before the model reads a line. Failures, numbers and decisive lines always survive.

docker logs
−99%
cargo test
−98%
git log
−97%
k8s manifests
−95%
pytest
−91%
943 command-specific compactors — 683 Linux · 126 macOS · 134 Windows · Measured compression — real sessions & benchmark corpus.
MCP optimization

Your MCP servers, on a token diet

One command wraps every MCP server. What they return is compacted before it reaches the model.

Screenshots and images pass through untouched · the full result stays recoverable.
Web search

Web search, rebuilt for agents

Same answers as compact result lists instead of walls of rendered text — with automatic fallback to the native tool.

Code search

A local search that understands your code

Semantic search, repo map, symbol query, file skeletons, impact analysis — your agent stops reading whole files to find one function.

Lean output

Models that skip the small talk

No pleasantries, recaps or filler — every technical detail kept. Output tokens are the most expensive ones.

Output-token reduction · Measured against vanilla Claude Code and Caveman — long sessions (>200k tokens), THOL benchmark.
Context optimization

A context window managed like a budget

Old context compacted before the prompt cache expires and re-bills it. Your agent nudged to batch independent commands.

Read deduplication

Never pay for the same bytes twice

Identical re-reads become a tiny reference — or just the diff when the content changed.

Measured on real sessions — the full bytes stay recoverable on demand.
Documents & media

Your agent reads the whole repo, not just the code

PDF specs, spreadsheets, recorded meetings — extracted properly instead of improvised at full price.

PDF, Office and OpenDocument, EPUB, 17 image formats, 65 audio/video — plus magic-byte detection for files with a wrong or missing extension.
Privacy

Your code never leaves your machine

100% local: your code, prompts and file paths never leave your machine, and the source is open for you to audit.

Security

Tokenade stops secret leaks

Secrets are redacted before they ever reach your model — or its provider.

Works where you work
